snippet.title: Regions of Ruin: Runegate Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a dwarven adventure in Regions of Ruin: Runegate, releasing on Steam and GOG on April 14th: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375750/Regions_of_Ruin_Runegate/

All that remains of the once-glorious dwarven civilization is dust, scattered exiles, and monster-infested landscapes. Venture on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure as a lone dwarf attempting to re-establish a haven for your dwarven kin - and delve into the mysteries of their forebears.
